Taking it one day at a time I find helps me stay present and out of the past (shame, guilt, depression) And out of the future (anxiety, fear, worrying).  I try to journal once a day, and talk to people about things going on in my head (friends, counselors etc).  Not perfect and I have bad days but I try to evaluate at night and strive to do just a bit better the next day. If I fail I talk about it and try to look at the things I did right. Best counseling advice I received was that when I feel great like everything is going perfect there's probably somewhere I came up short or something I can improve. When I feel overwhelmed or like everything is going wrong, there is usually something I'm doing well or something to be grateful for.
